outcome: Fetal redox status (PO2, SatHb, Ht, MDA concentration, TAC)
cohort: Forty twin-bearing ewes grazing on natural Patagonian prairie were randomly assigned to control, antioxidant, concentrate, or antioxidant plus concentrate groups.
finding: Maternal antioxidant supplementation significantly decreased fetal MDA concentration and showed a trend to increase fetal body weight, suggesting it may be a good nutritional strategy for early IUGR prevention.
cross-section timing: Fetal samples and measurements were obtained on day 100 of gestation.
birth_weight: Fetal body weight was measured as an outcome; no specific inclusion criterion based on weight was mentioned.
gest_age: Fetal samples and measurements were obtained on day 100 of gestation.
